dex.entry: A tiny night-spirit sprite that looks like a faint crescent cut from silver tissue paper; it drifts on the cold night air above Nightreach Observatory, emitting a soft high hum that unsettles nearby kin. A tiny sliver of moon given life — impossibly delicate and just a little unsettling.
